{{expand section|date=July 2025}}
'''Kai-Ming Ho''' is a senior physicist at [[Ames Laboratory]] and distinguished professor emeritus in the Department of Physics and Astronomy at [[Iowa State University]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Kai-Ming Ho |url=https://www.physastro.iastate.edu/people/kai-ming-ho |access-date=15 December 2025 |publisher=Iowa State University Department of Physics and Astronomy}}</ref>

== Honors ==
* 2012 [[Aneesur Rahman Prize]] for Computational Physics<ref name="apshonsearch"/>
*1995 Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]]<ref name="apshonsearch">{{cite news |title=Honors and Award Winners |url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/winners?q=Kai-Ming%20Ho&af=false |access-date=15 December 2025 |publisher=American Physical Society}}</ref>
